title: Immortal Execution Platform — AI Live-Action Version
description: An AI-generated, photoreal-style Chinese xianxia microdrama (斩仙台真人AI版) in which a modern protagonist is pulled into a Journey-to-the-West-flavored immortal world, adapted from a popular 2025 web-comic IP.
descriptionMore: Produced with AI tools in a "真人" (live-action-style) look rather than 2D animation, the series topped Hongguo's AI-drama charts after reportedly clearing 100 million views within six days of release, en route to well over a billion cumulative views. Across 81 episodes, it leans on the genre's familiar isekai-into-immortal-cultivation setup.
